subject: english-core
source: CBSE 2026-27 sample question paper (cbseacademic.nic.in); verify against the official SQP before an exam build.

sections.name: Section A: Reading Skills
sections.note: One unseen passage (12 marks) and one case-based/factual passage (10 marks), each with MCQ, short-answer and inference items.

sections.name: Section B: Creative Writing Skills
sections.note: Notice or invitation (4 marks, with choice), letter (5 marks, with choice), article or report (5 marks, with choice), plus a 4-mark short format; see the SQP for the exact set.

sections.name: Section C: Literature
sections.note: Extract-based items from poetry and prose, short answers (40–50 words) and long answers (120–150 words) from Flamingo and Vistas, with internal choices.

notes: English Core does not fit a fixed count × marks grid, so exam mode uses fixed paper files for this subject.
